name: Find and Move Categorized Object
definition: Locate an object matching a given category (living, non-living, plant, or animal), focus on it, and move it to a specified box.

name: Measure Temperature and Sort
definition: Use a thermometer to measure the current temperature of a specified substance or object and place it in one of two boxes based on a threshold.

name: Determine Melting Point
definition: Use a thermometer to determine the melting point of a specified substance and focus on the box matching whether it is above or below a threshold.

name: Test Electrical Conductivity
definition: Determine whether a specified object is electrically conductive and place it in the box corresponding to the result.

name: Change State of Matter
definition: Heat or cool a specified substance until it changes its state of matter.

name: Create Substance by Recipe
definition: Follow a recipe or chemical mixing procedure to create a specified substance and focus on the requested product(s).

name: Grow Plant from Seed
definition: Grow a specified plant from a seed by providing appropriate soil, water, and light until it reaches the target life stage.

name: Grow Fruit by Crosspollination
definition: Grow multiple plants from seed and crosspollinate them to produce a specified fruit, then focus on the fruit.

name: Identify Animal by Lifespan
definition: Identify the animal(s) with the longest and/or shortest lifespan among the available animals, and focus on the requested animal(s) in the requested order.

name: Order Life Stages
definition: Focus on the life stages of a specified organism (plant or animal) in the correct order from earliest to latest.
